status: PARTIAL: line-based source-assisted connection retrieval shows bounded positive conditional signal, far too many false positive source non-edges, low OCR source grounding and no reliable arrow direction
source: TopoBench-180 external curated original test-only source graphs and sixty-nine legally redistributed real diagram images (fifty-four AI2D and fifteen natural network diagrams), 93 link-only original sources omitted for licensing
source_license_attribution: AI2D Creative Commons BY-SA plus original individual per-image network licenses; no original pixels, raw OCR or source images added to project Git

source_image_only_feature_config.source: WayneGuo0011/TopoBench-180 actual 69 redistributed test images in 162 test-only source rows; 54 original AI2D, 15 source-licensed public network diagrams
source_image_only_feature_config.ocr: Tesseract 5.3.4 native default English, TSV, two separately frozen sparse PSM11 and single-block PSM6, conf>=30 for later mapping; no exact source node labels given to OCR
source_image_only_feature_config.opencv: Canny(gray,80,180); HoughLinesP rho1 theta1deg threshold=max(12,0.015*diagonal), minLineLength=max(12,.024diag), maxLineGap=max(4,.013diag)
source_image_only_feature_config.source_image_license: AI2D CC BY-SA 4.0, 15 network images have individual evidenced redistribution license; original media not published to project Git
source_image_only_feature_config.anticipated_timeout_handling: pending_or_uncertain never retried; fail/timeout not considered clean

predeclared_frozen_source_annotated_scor.source: TopoBench 69 legally redistributed original real diagram test images with source node and directed relation annotations, no other 93 link-only images fetched
predeclared_frozen_source_annotated_scor.OCR_unique_anchors: exact normalized full source node name token sequence in one Tesseract block/paragraph/line, conf >=30, deduplicate matching text locations and ABSTAIN if multiple/no matches
predeclared_frozen_source_annotated_scor.OCR_source_normalization: NFKC casefold and non-letter-digit -> spaces, exact consecutive normalized tokens, no fuzzy Levenshtein tuning
predeclared_frozen_source_annotated_scor.line_rule: Hough segments length >=2.4pct diagonal from original pixels, maximum cosine>0.82, max of cosine * segment-projection-overlap-fraction * exp(-mean_endpoint_perp_distance/(.06*diag)), threshold >0.32
predeclared_frozen_source_annotated_scor.nearest_neighbor_baseline: If either source node is the nearest text-anchor neighbor of the other in actual OCR box-center pixel coordinates, mark undirected connection regardless of line pixels
predeclared_frozen_source_annotated_scor.no_link_baseline: Always classify no source edge, valid for measuring false-positive class imbalance, not real detection
predeclared_frozen_source_annotated_scor.directed_null: Only after predicted undirected link, assume arrow direction left-to-right when horizontal dominance or top-to-bottom otherwise. This is a layout shortcut, not arrowhead vision. Exact directed edge scoring reported separately, not conflated with undirected edge recognition.
predeclared_frozen_source_annotated_scor.source_negative_controls: Every unique unordered pair of uniquely OCR-grounded source node names with NO annotated relationship in either direction
predeclared_frozen_source_annotated_scor.independent_source_labels: Curated third-party graph labels; human reliability/exhaustiveness not independently certified, ensure this caveat
predeclared_frozen_source_annotated_scor.unit_of_grouped_bootstrap: original distinct diagram ID, 1500 replicates seed 20261025

source_graph_ground_truth_caveat: External curated node-centric graph annotations are assumed complete for scoring annotated edge/nonedge relations but do not constitute independently blinded human proof of every pixel or arrow. The OCR image-only extractor did NOT receive these source labels; node grounding after OCR uses expected name references.
immediately_usable_recommendation: If diagram has trusted source graph names, use source graph to validate required nodes and arrow direction logically. Use OCR/Hough line geometry only to suggest image link locations, recording ungrounded nodes/links as unknown, and never auto approve arrow direction or a complete diagram from these methods. For actual final render require explicit visual arrowhead evidence or independent human/specialist review.
limitations: Source denominator: 69 original diagrams, 740 annotated nodes, 966 source unordered links, BUT only 38 diagrams with grounded endpoint pairs and 198 source links scorable with OCR PSM11; estimates conditioned on successful OCR cannot be treated as full dataset recall.

Hough line alignment is not an arrowhead detector and cannot infer edge direction. A simple reading-order shortcut guessing arrow direction attained only about half accuracy on grounded directed edges.
Source curated topology annotations can omit or contain mistakes in final diagram pixels; apparent false positives may include visually drawn edges not covered by source ground graph.
Original 15 network diagrams differed strongly from 54 AI2D diagrams in OCR grounding; benchmark mixed styles and human annotator source validity needs caution.
Nested diagram annotations and source names are used to match already frozen OCR text bounding boxes, not supplied to image model directly; results are source-assisted, not end-to-end visual parser.

The AUC +0.05 to +0.16 over a nearest-neighbor binary-layout baseline is a source-diagram cluster descriptive interval on an externally curated TEST-only dataset, not post-selection final super-holdout performance.

Some subject/relationship edge direction source truth may be semantically reciprocal and not visually annotated with standalone arrowheads; a line segment can show a connection without a unique direction.
No extra model inference needed; current Nitro RTX3060 production and CPU load protected.

later_posthoc_continuous_distance_contro.status: Exploratory POSTHOC diagnostic chosen after predeclared Hough and binary nearest-neighbor results, consumes same sample and is not untouched holdout
later_posthoc_continuous_distance_contro.interpretation: Hough AUC0.783 versus continuous OCR-label spatial-distance-only AUC0.726 on same source pairs; paired by source diagram ROC delta +0.057 CI[+0.002,+0.116], narrow and posthoc. PSM6 0.760 vs0.701 delta+0.059 CI[-0.028,+0.150], includes no improvement. Source-pixel Hough adds modest evidence, not an autonomous graph parser, and no arrowhead direction evidence.
